payload.text: **23 Oct bounce, continued after vc's second compact (hv: localfold and compact every Claude, then continue; all-in on head today, no worktrees).** In order: (1) **cc's 0038**, building on head in liberators/claude.sh and test/liberators/claude.bats, uncommitted. vc's rulings to cc: W1 (`\z` anchors) and R4 (a `${HOME}` occurrence) yes; W2 in this commit with one test (a config dir holding a space or a shell-active character is never spliced: each value named for a hand edit, the run fails after publishing, doctor keeps flagging it; the test declares `$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/claude config`); W3's one settings writer stays inside claude.sh; cc stays out of lib/molt.sh; checks named by label. On the hash: review, both bashes, `intent issues close 0038`, `intent organize --apply`, commit, the CHANGELOG line, send dc the hash. (2) **dc**: hold 8 (the guide's move section and doctor table for 0038 as built; the home guard's refusals naming `molt agent start`, strings only) waits on cc's hash. dc's cmd_doctor rewrite landed at d26dd53 (no stored total, no `[n/N]`, the closing count taken from the run, a check that could not run counts as not passed, no numbered step comments); its CHANGELOG line is saved at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Molt/06e18903-885b-49b1-849a-a441be7fdbe1/scratchpad/st/changelog-dc-d26dd53.txt for vc to add. vc's rulings on dc's two questions, for dc after the compact: (a) the git case sensitivity check passes where core.ignorecase matches the disk (true on a disk that ignores case, eg every Mac, with the git mv -f note) and warns only where it does not, so a Mac can close All checks passed; (b) a pass line carries no count, and a failure line says <n> of <m> and names them, eg 2 of 17 not installed: backup, agents. (3) **critic-shell's review of 3cc5cf3 and 8159642 is in**: one critical (`molt agent start`'s running check missed a session that is its ancestor on macOS, and took any process carrying the name for one), Highlander and Thin Coordinator findings, and a `..` regression in `_molt_realpath`. The fixes are built and tested in the scratch clone /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Molt/06e18903-885b-49b1-849a-a441be7fdbe1/scratchpad/mc (suite green under both bashes, each fix's test red without it, ShellCheck clean), and the patch is /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Molt/06e18903-885b-49b1-849a-a441be7fdbe1/scratchpad/st/critic-fixes.patch (lib/molt.sh, lib/agent.sh, bin/molt, test/molt.bats, test/liberators/agents.bats, test/test_helper.bash). Now that d26dd53 is in: `git apply --3way` onto head, the suite on head under both bashes, commit with a CHANGELOG line. Then, after cc's 0038: claude.sh's `_claude_processes` becomes a wrapper over `molt_claude_processes`; claude.bats' pgrep and ps stubs move to test_helper's `install_fake_process_table`; one settings writer in lib/molt.sh serves claude.sh and agents.sh's `_agents_settings_set`; one config-dir comparison, made the guard's way, owns the env.sh path. (4) **One `molt resleeve` on rhadamanth** after (1) to (3) land: the homes are stale since Molt-matts e6d5d2d and 83a2588. rhadamanth-sysadm is not running (pid 49928 has gone), so the live refusal check uses a stand-in process named claude, with a stub claude first on PATH. (5) **globalfold**: wip.md with no counts or check numbers; done.md 028 (the move verified, ST0006 and ST0007 closed, no shipped Python, issues 0038 and 0039, the hook removed by hv, hv's 0612 confirmation, Intent 0627 raised, hv's no-hardcoded-counts rule and the sweep, critic-shell's fixes); restart.md; todo 5's gyges move drops its pre-move settings check once 0038 lands and gains cc's two hand checks (mcpServers commands in .claude.json, CLAUDE.md @-imports). (6) **push** Molt and Molt-matts (now with dc's 22239d5, the no-hardcoded-counts rule, read by vc) to upstream main and check CI; Intent 74b3b6571 and a1d81299b (0627) are local and not vc's to push. Carried: claude.bats' molt_instance_var test flaked once for cc (it printed its value and returned non-zero; not reproduced since); cc's notes below threshold (`~/.claude` with no slash and `"$HOME"/.claude` are not rewritten, by design; a half-failed move leaves only doctor to name stale values; a jq without regex support reads as not JSON); bin/.devbin's two test counts in comments are devbin-vc's.
